# gpuq 0.3.0

## English

- Run one task on multiple GPUs on the same host with `--gpus N`.
- Schedule projects fairly with persistent project and total concurrency limits.
- Submit and manage tasks over SSH with incremental code snapshots, reusable Python environments,
  model caches, and explicit checkpoint uploads.
- Optionally combine local and remote GPUs into one queue backed by three etcd voting members,
  with master election, standby takeover and preferred-master failback.
- Configure bounded retries for disconnected tasks, with separate execution directories,
  stale-result protection and cancellation of superseded work when a node returns.
- Display CLI text/JSON timestamps in local time with explicit offsets; keep UTC storage and logs.

Existing local queues remain usable. Cluster mode is explicit and requires separate setup; each task
runs on one host. Node-loss retries may duplicate an old execution during a network partition, and
use the originally submitted inputs rather than retrieving the lost node's latest checkpoint.

See the [cluster guide](https://github.com/lzy248/gpuq/blob/v0.3.0/docs/cluster_usage.en.md), [remote guide](https://github.com/lzy248/gpuq/blob/v0.3.0/docs/remote_usage.en.md)
and [changelog](https://github.com/lzy248/gpuq/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.md) for setup and details.

## 中文

- `--gpus N` 支持同一个任务使用同一主机上的多张 GPU。
- 按项目公平调度，持久保存项目与总并发上限。
- 通过 SSH 提交和管理任务，增量同步代码快照，复用 Python 环境、模型缓存，显式上传续训文件。
- 可选三成员 etcd 统一本地与远程 GPU 队列，支持选主、备节点接管和原主回切。
- 支持有界失联重排，使用独立执行目录、隔离旧结果，并在节点恢复时取消被替代执行。
- CLI 文本/JSON 时间按本地时区显示并带 offset，存储与日志保持 UTC。

已有本地队列可继续使用。集群模式需显式配置，每个任务仍在一台主机运行。
网络分区期间失联重排可能重复执行；重跑使用原提交输入，不自动取回失联节点的最新 checkpoint。

配置和详情见[集群手册](https://github.com/lzy248/gpuq/blob/v0.3.0/docs/cluster_usage.md)、[远程手册](https://github.com/lzy248/gpuq/blob/v0.3.0/docs/remote_usage.md)
及[变更日志](https://github.com/lzy248/gpuq/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.md)。
